concerns.text: Tasks T001‑T005 are marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but they all write to the same project directory tree (creating directories, writing `requirements.txt`, `pyproject.toml`, utils, and CLI files). Running them concurrently can cause race conditions (e.g., T001 must finish before T004/T005 can place files inside the newly created directories). The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate; these tasks should be sequential or the tag removed.
